payload.name: The Fairy Court
payload.description: You materialize in a moonlit glade. Tiny winged figures dance around you. A fairy queen approaches.

choices.description: The fairy queen nods respectfully. 'Wise, perhaps. Or foolish.' You find yourself back where you started.

success.description: Quick as a shadow, you pocket a handful of glittering fairy dust!

failure.description: The fairies catch you! They curse you with bad luck and eject you from the glade.

authority: Custom Crown campaign event, not an SRD trap/NPC/spell replacement
occurrence_policy: Table may roll again; same in-flight occurrence must not reroll/reapply on reopen. Campaign-specific uniqueness beyond generated room claims is unresolved, not silently global once-per-event-ID.
